turns.text: What are the different ways to register for an ABHA?

Registration via Aadhaar uses Aadhaar OTP verification and returns the full profile with the ABHA number. Registration via mobile is being deprecated. Registration via another ID document, such as a driving licence, needs a linked mobile number and OTP verification.
A walk-in patient only has a driving licence and a phone, which route do I use?

must_contain: use the identity document route, NHA's own collection uses a driving licence
you need a working session token, the patient's mobile number with them present to read an OTP, and the document details
the account this produces is restricted until it is upgraded through Aadhaar KYC
notes: follow-up narrows a listed set of methods to one concrete case; the second answer is the by-document flow atom.
